title: Return an independent value snapshot
prompt: Copy all readings into a new vector, add delta to each copied value, and return it. Inputs and results fit int. The caller’s original vector must not change, including when it is empty.
signature: std::vector<int> shifted(const std::vector<int>& readings, int delta)

tests.label: Shift three
tests.hint: Change each item in the copy.

tests.label: Empty remains empty
tests.hint: No special object needs to be created.

tests.label: Original stays put
tests.hint: The returned vector owns its own elements.

hints: Copy the vector before the loop.
A reference in for(int& value:result) lets the loop change that copied element.
explanation: A vector copy has its own element storage. A const reference only borrows input. The caller still owns its original after the function returns.
